summary: Correct the citation for makule b-ruḥe
rationale: 112/152 contains a rebuke about entering the town and has no makule b ruḥe. Supplied 112/158 explicitly has komər makule b ruḥe ... kani kayiwo in the scene where he pretends to be ill. The automatic best match 112/173 instead has maməṯle and must not be used.

summary: There are four of you → There are forty of you
rationale: Arbʕi means forty, confirmed by arbʕi ḥeḏore in 73/6 and arbʕi ḥwoṯe in 73/10. The supplied 73/8 translation has Ihr seid vierzig. Four misstates the number.
